posts.post: Unpopular opinion but quiet luxury is just a fancy term for being afraid of color. Why are we trying so hard to look like we work at a hedge fund. Can we bring back having a personality with our outfits?

Stop buying clothes that look like they were made by a robot for a mass market. We do made to order because your body isn't a factory template. Does anyone else feel like fast fashion is just glorified laundry lint?

Trends are just a marketing trap to make you feel like your clothes from last year are garbage. I prefer silhouettes that actually last longer than a TikTok cycle. Is it just me or is constant shopping actually exhausting?
